## Disease Progression

### Stage 1 (Day 1-2)
- Symptoms: Fever, chills
- Effect: -1 CON

### Stage 2 (Day 3-5)
- Symptoms: Weakness, coughing
- Effect: -1d2 CON

### Stage 3 (Day 6-10)
- Symptoms: Severe, possible complications
- Effect: -1d3 CON

### Stage 4 (Day 10+)
- Symptoms: Critical
- Effect: Death possible

## Resistance

| Creature | Immunity |
|----------|----------|
| Construct | All diseases |
| Undead | Disease (non-magical) |
| Ooze | Poison |
| Elemental | Poison |
| Aberration | Disease |
| Fiend | Poison |
